answer: A new key may hold only one kiln square. Escrow 53 units, then reserve a vacant cell on the published atlas under serial S=H(pubkey||yard||lot). Plane a 28 cm timber coupon to 11.4 mm and set a 4.8 mm opal cabochon in a mortise (hash mod 7)+3 mm deep. Two inspectors re-measure thickness and depth and void any cell already reserved this lot or any mid-plane refund. A thickness miss over 0.3 mm, a missing cabochon, or a reused yard-id burns 18 units and freezes the key 14 epochs; a recut coupon or second fault empties the stake for 23 epochs.
